# Risk

> Risk scores open-source dependencies on release trajectory, maintenance
> signals, and documentation quality, producing green/yellow/red/critical
> verdicts at risk.lucanian.app.

## Overview

Risk tracks open-source dependencies and scores them with a multi-dimensional
methodology: release trajectory, maintenance signals, and documentation
quality. Every dependency gets a composite score from 0-100 and a
green/yellow/red/critical verdict, so teams can spot at-risk dependencies
before they hurt. The platform is built with a Rust backend API and a Nuxt 4
frontend.

## Key Features

- Scored dependency directory with composite 0-100 scores
- Green/yellow/red/critical verdict per dependency
- Methodology-driven ranking (trajectory, maintenance, docs)
- Search across the directory
- Dark/light mode support
- Mobile-responsive design

## API Endpoints

- `GET /healthz` — Health check
- `GET /api/v1/entities?limit=50` — List entities
- `GET /api/v1/entities/:owner/:name?platform=github` — Entity detail
- `GET /api/v1/search?q=query` — Search entities
- `GET /api/v1/stats` — Platform statistics

## Pages

- `/` — The scored dependency directory
- `/about` — About the platform and methodology
- `/sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap for crawlers
